_comment: Serf-specific model metadata overlays. Merged on top of litellm_model_catalog.json at load time. These fields are not available upstream and must be maintained here. An entry absent from the LiteLLM base is materialized as a Serf-only catalog model when it carries context_window; max_output_tokens overlays/materializes the output cap. reasoning_effort_levels are wire-spelled (e.g. ["high","max"]): serf's ClampReasoningEffort raises below-range requests to the lowest supported level and resolves the top tier to the model's own spelling, so a wire-spelled list replaces any per-model thinking map.

glm-4.5-air._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only; keeps profile default ladder.

glm-4.7._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5-turbo._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5.1._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5.2._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). Effort param supported; Pi thinkingLevelMap {minimal:null,low/medium/high:high,xhigh:max} == wire-spelled levels [high,max] under serf's clamp.

glm-5v-turbo._note: z.ai GLM stock vision model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

deepseek-v4-flash._note: DeepSeek V4 (Pi deepseek.models.ts). Slimmed 2026-07-02 when upstream added the model: context/output caps now come from LiteLLM (upstream max_output 8192 beats Pi's 384000 — an over-cap 400s, an under-cap merely truncates); serf keeps only the effort-vocabulary fields upstream lacks.

deepseek-v4-pro._note: DeepSeek V4 (Pi deepseek.models.ts). Slimmed 2026-07-02 when upstream added the model: context/output caps now come from LiteLLM (upstream max_output 8192 beats Pi's 384000 — an over-cap 400s, an under-cap merely truncates); serf keeps only the effort-vocabulary fields upstream lacks.

claude-sonnet-5._note: Anthropic Sonnet 5 (platform.claude.com, verified 2026-07-11). Base LiteLLM entry carries context/pricing; overlay adds the effort ladder + adaptive thinking (the DEFAULT when thinking is omitted).

claude-fable-5._note: Anthropic Fable 5 (platform.claude.com, verified 2026-07-11). Thinking is ALWAYS ON — sending thinking disabled is an API 400, hence thinking_always_on.

gpt-5.6-sol._note: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol (developers.openai.com, released 2026-07-09). Not in the LiteLLM catalog — materialized. Context 1,050,000 per first-party API docs (codex's models.json says 372,000; the API docs win). "ultra" is a codex-client-only effort concept and is deliberately absent.

gpt-5.6-terra._note: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra (developers.openai.com, released 2026-07-09). Materialized; see gpt-5.6-sol note.

gpt-5.6-luna._note: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna (developers.openai.com, released 2026-07-09). Materialized; see gpt-5.6-sol note.

minimax/minimax-m2.7._note: MiniMax M2.7 stock model. Materialized 2026-07-02 when the LiteLLM refresh dropped the upstream entry (real, still-served model): context/capabilities restored from the pre-refresh snapshot.

kimi-for-coding._note: Serf-only entry — the Kimi coding plan's single model (K2.7 Code); not in the LiteLLM catalog. context_window present, so this materializes a catalog entry.

openrouter/anthropic/claude-3-haiku-2024._note: Still served by OpenRouter; the 2026-07-02 LiteLLM refresh dropped the dated entry. Materialized from the pre-refresh snapshot (also a profile-resolution test fixture).
